The second phase of Keys’ plan begins: By manipulating Mahanagar’s advanced water systems, a great flood will sweep through the outer districts. Tens of thousands of Bugs will drown, leaving the Brain Bug trapped and isolated.

// NAME: // ============== /OBJECTIVES/STAGE 1: POLICE HQ FLOORS/PRISON FLOOR/PRISON: REACH ELEVATOR/TRIGGERS/DIALOGUE: DRONES INCOMING ==============

column2: [Bug scream]
Whoa, that's an awful screech!
The face at the end of it is even worse. Drones on the way!

// NAME: // ============== /OBJECTIVES/STAGE 1: POLICE HQ FLOORS/PRISON FLOOR/PRISON: REACH ELEVATOR/BRIEFING ==============

column2: You've proved handy 'til now, Keys. My team's in your charge -- lead the way.
It almost sounds like you're enjoying working with me, Major.
Heh. Don't push your luck, kid. Just get us through this.
Well then, Major, the main elevator should be accessible through this jail floor. It'll take us to the basement level.
You lead, we'll follow.

// NAME: // ============== /OBJECTIVES/STAGE 1: POLICE HQ FLOORS/PRISON FLOOR/PRISON: GET TO THE COLLAPSED FLOOR/TRIGGERS/DIALOGUE: CAPTURE TURRETS ==============

column2: More Drones incoming! Those turrets will thin the herd real good!

// NAME: // ============== /OBJECTIVES/STAGE 1: POLICE HQ FLOORS/PRISON FLOOR/PRISON: GET TO THE COLLAPSED FLOOR/TRIGGERS/DIALOGUE: ENTER THE HOLE ==============

column2: On the money again, Keys. Intel could really use an asset like you. How the hell were you not screened before?
Never had much time for all that, after dad died.
My intuition -- or, what I thought was just "intuition" -- is how I survived then, and hell, it's how I'll survive this too.

// NAME: // ============== /OBJECTIVES/STAGE 1: POLICE HQ FLOORS/PRISON FLOOR/PRISON: GET TO THE COLLAPSED FLOOR/BRIEFING ==============

column2: Elevator's a bust. What now, kid?
The Bugs must've had a way up here. If we just find their hole, we can get down.
That a hunch, or your intuition?
Let's just call it good old-fashioned cop work, Major. You gotta take some swings to make it in this line of work.

// NAME: // ============== /OBJECTIVES/STAGE 1: POLICE HQ FLOORS/STORAGE FLOOR/STORAGE: REACH THE STAIRS/BRIEFING ==============

column2: Down we go.
You “sensing” a quicker way down? Gonna take damn long doing this one floor at a time...
If you can manage a hike, there should be a stairway leading all the way to reception through this floor.

// NAME: // ============== /OBJECTIVES/STAGE 1: POLICE HQ FLOORS/STORAGE FLOOR/STORAGE: AMMO DEPOT/TRIGGERS/SUCCESS ==============

column2: I'm not sure I want to know how some lowlife got his hands on heavy Fed tech, but he's done us a favor this time!

// NAME: // ============== /OBJECTIVES/STAGE 1: POLICE HQ FLOORS/STORAGE FLOOR/STORAGE: AMMO DEPOT/BRIEFINGS ==============

column2: The station stashes any confiscated weaponry in a locker ahead, Major. Might be something useful for us.
Assuming your colleagues haven't already cleaned it out, then it's worth a look.

// NAME: // ============== /OBJECTIVES/STAGE 1: POLICE HQ FLOORS/RECEPTION/RECEPTION: ACTIVATE POWER/TRIGGERS/DIALOGUE: LOST COPS ==============

column2: My god! They slaughtered half the station! I... should have been here...
Sorry, Keys, but you learn quick in this job that you can't save everyone all the time. I've been trying to get that through to you.
Best you can do is pick your battles where you can and swear payback for those left behind.
Saddle up, boys. We got a long way down.
Just the 30 floors to go. Can your M.I. keep up with my so-called "flatfoots"?
"Mobile" is in the name, you know...
Finally at reception -- I think my guys take that one, Major.
The elevator here can get us the rest of the way down now. Access to the sewer pumps is through the parking garage.
But we'll need to restore power to this floor first.
Hmph... I'm calling it a tie.
Bugs comin' in from outside! Block 'em out!
Power's running again. Let's get to the elevator.
Can't park here, Bugs. This spot's taken.
'Course -- more Bugs infesting the place. Clear 'em out and don't let 'em back in!
Bug nests cleared. You're up, Keys. Get us into the sewer.
On it.
Door's open. Everyone in!
One pump down!
Second pump activated! Thanks for the years of lectures, dad.
Welcome to the real Mahanagar -- the nerve center of the greatest city in the galaxy is ahead of you.
The city would sink without these water pumps regulating the mains system. Today however, they're also our best weapon against the Bugs.
Fed engineering -- it's a beautiful thing. Your daddy teach you all about this?
Despite my best efforts, yes. Overloading just three pumps should be enough to flood out the Bugs in the outer districts.
Then we'll have ol' wrinkle sack cut-off and wailing for support from his colony. Too bad most of 'em will be busy drowning...
'Bout time we get out of here. I'm in the mood to watch some Bugs drown back up top.
Hoping this worked...
It will. You did damn fine here, Keys. Damn fine indeed.
That's the last pump done! This place will be flooded real soon!
I don't much like swimmin' in shit! Let's double time it to the maintenance elevator!
Spiders, slugs, scorpions...you can keep making 'em as big as you want, I'll still stomp 'em down!
What the hell is that Bug!?
Same as the rest of 'em -- ugly and in need of squashin'! Drop the sucker!
